result.title: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
result.summary: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

AI.brief_summary: EdgeKernelBench 提出统一 IR 部署框架与分层边缘负载基准，用于系统评测 LLM 在异构边缘后端生成 kernel 的能力，并提出基于分层 IR 的 agent（LEKA）进行分层优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 分层 IR 表示与带优化预算的 agent 式分层优化，可能为 LVR 的分层 latent 状态组织与计算分配提供参照；其将正确率与性能分开度量（Correct@1 与 Fast@1.0 的明显落差）也提示「功能正确未必带来收益」这类评价设计可供核查，但与原研究主线距离较远。
